purpose: Held-out real-drawing qualitative probes for the A-Z font trial
usage: Inference/visual inspection only; do not include in train or validation datasets
limitation: No per-character labels; not a labeled full-drawing detection metric
coordinate_system: PDF points, top-left origin, x rightwards, y downwards

probes.preserved_context: Unaltered PDF crop, including surrounding linework and non-Latin characters
probes.evaluation_note: Qualitative only; expected text is from a prior visually checked source script, not new character annotations
probes.visual_inspection: Angular, single-line uppercase glyphs visually resemble the supplied A-Z strip. Glyphs are tightly set and some edges touch; leader lines lie directly below the word and a circled numeral is retained.
